settings.customCharacterStyle: HARD LOCK. Older brother is always the taller East Asian child with fair/light skin, rounded-square face, dark-brown almond eyes, neat side-swept dark-brown hair, cream hoodie, light-green vest, tan shorts, white sneakers, green wristband and square backpack. Younger brother is always shorter with fair/light skin, rounder face, slightly larger dark-brown almond eyes, fluffy-front dark-brown hair, white shirt, bright-blue hoodie, navy shorts, blue-white sneakers and blue utility pouch. settings.customProjectStructure: 16 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Scene N+1 must start exactly from Scene N continuityEndFrame. Scene 1 uses Character Sheets as primary reference. Scene 2 onward uses Character Sheets plus the immediately previous generated scene image. One main action, one camera movement, one speaker maximum. No teleporting, no obstacle reset, no disappearing props, no readable character labels or UI.
